notes.title: Linux version updated
notes.content:
Fixed some Linux-specific issues.
Support for the game controllers added.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
Missions at the Hard level has been adjusted: 7 super-tough missions became easier.
Fixed bug with Alt-Tab in full screen mode.

notes.title: Fixed issue with font caching at high DPI
notes.content: Fixed issue with font caching at high DPI (4K screens) which may cause game crash.

notes.title: Linux version updated
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that may cause game freeze. 
[*] Fixed music looping on Linux.
[*] Additional built-in debug and watchdog tools added.
[/list]

notes.title: Mixing strategy, puzzles and cards 'Astral Towers' comes to Linux with the latest update
notes.content:
Combining together a turn-based card game that needs strategy and a little puzzle solving, Astral Towers along with the open source game engine powering it comes to Linux.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/mixing-strategy-puzzles-and-cards-astral-towers-comes-to-linux-with-the-latest-update
